status_note: Twenty non-lookup observation records are byte-identical between locked Ghidra 12.0.4 and the candidate Rugra source. They cover RuleIdentityEl's complete getOpList order, every registered opcode, both successful INT_MULT branches, non-constant and non-identity guards, explicit INT_SUB/INT_AND dispatch negatives, opcode/input/output identity mutation, ordered descendants/block order, raw Rule name, fixed-point result, and Action/Rule counters through each side's production ActionPool. The whole observation remains MISMATCH because locked Ghidra's production ActionPool::getSubRule resolves identityel and rejects identity_el, while the pinned Rugra ActionPool has no production get_sub_rule API; the Rust lookup record says lookup=missing and uses only its fixture-only read view to show the corrected name is uniquely registered. The other 111 inventoried Rule raw-name differences are not changed by this narrow batch and remain bound to PIPE-RULE-RAW-NAMES-0001.

rugra_source.overlay: Only the owned candidate src/ruleaction.rs replaces the pinned base file; src/action.rs stays at the recorded base blob so the fixture observes the real current ActionPool without expanding this write-set.

analysis_options.action: One production ActionPool with RULE_REPEATAPPLY and exactly one production RuleIdentityEl; Action::perform drives it to a fixed point.
analysis_options.funcdata: GetStr symbol at 0x36d0 from pinned examples/curl, with a fresh synthetic BlockBasic and eleven alive operations added through Funcdata APIs.
analysis_options.ir: Shared four-byte integer input reads nine ops; shared one-byte boolean input reads two ops; every constant is a distinct Varnode. Operations are inserted in the recorded case order at monotonically increasing code addresses 0x6100..0x610a.
analysis_options.normalization: None. Opcode numbers, input/output pointer-identity booleans, descendant and block iteration order, counts, status, parent/dead state, and final newlines are compared verbatim.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and ActionPool execution are deterministic

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({architecture,compiler_spec,analysis_options,binary,functions,cases}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

observation_schema.format: Twenty-one fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline; the one lookup line is the registered whole-observation mismatch, while the other twenty lines form the zero-difference covered projection.
observation_schema.dispatch: Exact ordered getOpList plus RuleIdentityEl registered through production ActionPool on both sides; non-members never reach applyOp.
observation_schema.mutations: Final opcode/input count and slot-to-original-input identity, stable output/def identity, rhs descendant count, parent identity, and dead state per op.
observation_schema.ordering: Shared-input descendant order and BasicBlock operation order before and after fixed-point execution.
observation_schema.counters: ActionPool perform result/status/count_tests/count_apply plus Rule-level attempted/successful application counts; Rust Rule counters are a fixture-only transparent wrapper because Rule fields live in the C++ base class only.
observation_schema.name_lookup: Raw Rule name on both sides; locked Ghidra production getSubRule lookup and explicit Rust production-API absence plus a read-only unique-name scan.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: RuleIdentityEl mutates the shared PcodeOp and Funcdata in place. Non-multiply zero and multiply-one remove slot 1 while preserving slot-0 identity; multiply-zero removes slot 0 so the original rhs becomes slot 0. Output Varnode identity/def and op parent remain unchanged.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: getOpList appends exactly indices 0 through 5 in source order. ActionPool traverses the eleven alive ops in SeqNum/insertion order, restarts a changed op at the COPY bucket, and repeats the bank until no count increase. Descendants are observed in addDescend insertion order before/after removals.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: Action count starts at zero for one perform call, first pool pass accumulates seven changes, second pass adds none, yielding perform=7/status_start/tests=1/apply=1. Rule counters span both passes: nine first-pass registered attempts plus the two unchanged registered guards on the repeat pass, for tests=11/apply=7.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: Dispatch keys are exact numeric OpCode values. Name lookup keys are exact raw strings identityel versus identity_el with uniqueness required. Pointer identity comparisons distinguish original lhs/rhs/output/parent; no allocation ID normalization or unordered sorting occurs.

getoplist_and_raw_name.covers: Exact six-op ordered list INT_ADD, INT_XOR, INT_OR, BOOL_XOR, BOOL_OR, INT_MULT and exact raw name identityel.

positive_apply_paths.covers: Zero collapse for every non-multiply registered opcode and both INT_MULT identity cases 0/1 through production fixed-point dispatch.

negative_paths.covers: INT_MULT value 2 and INT_ADD non-constant guards plus decisive INT_SUB/INT_AND dispatch refusal.

identity_order_and_counters.covers: Opcode/input/output identities, rhs descendant removal/retention, ordered shared descendants, block order, parent/dead state, Action state/counts, and transparent Rule attempt/apply counts.

production_get_sub_rule.covers: Locked Ghidra getSubRule(identityel) returns the registered Rule and rejects identity_el; pinned Rugra ActionPool has no production get_sub_rule method.

other_rule_raw_names.covers: This batch corrects RuleIdentityEl only; the other 111 independently inventoried raw-name differences remain outside its write-set.

breakpoints_disable_warning_reset.covers: Rule breakpoint resume, disable/enable, warning toggles, reset/resetStats and exceptional/malformed IR are not exercised by this narrow fixture.

build.ghidra: Archive locked e40ed130 decompiler C++ tree, rebuild libdecomp.a, and link the fixture with the recorded BFD header/library.
